correctness.rationale: Actual frozen Git tree confirms RESULT and the normal-fan edge classification: adjacent occupied numerical-value swaps have Euclidean length sqrt2; rank edges inserting the smallest occupied value have cost t=n−k+1. For each rank-k vertex, uniform completion over missing labels defines a probability on the top facet. Swaps couple at cost sqrt2; inserting t admits a coupling of mean cost at most j/sqrt2 strictly below edge length t≥j+1. W1 triangle inequality bounds any ambient path below by the facet Coxeter distance; a path departing the facet incurs strict slack. Independently checked exact graph adjacency and shortest path equality for (m,n)=(2,2),(3,3),(3,4),(4,4), up to 65 vertices and 2080 endpoint pairs; finite tests are corroboration only.
